{attribute 'qualified_only'} {attribute 'strict'} TYPE E_ServoSeqState : ( Idle := 0, // all at standstill, ungeared Positioning, // Ax1 -> offset 1, Ax2 -> offset 2, VM -> 0 GearingIn, // Ax1, Ax2 gear in to VM, absolute to set point, 1:1 Synced, // geared, VM at standstill VmRunning, // VM velocity at speed command VmSpeedChange, // one scan: re-enter VmRunning to apply a new speed VmHalting, // VM decelerates to standstill Ungearing, // slaves halted, gearing ended AbortVm, // VM stopped at abort deceleration AbortSlaves // slaves stopped at abort deceleration, gearing ended ); END_TYPE

TYPE ST_AxisCyclicStatus : STRUCT // Status bits DataValid : BOOL; // cyclic data is valid Homed : BOOL; // axis is referenced Standstill : BOOL; // axis does not move (within standstill window) PowerReady : BOOL; // drive is ready for power up PowerOn : BOOL; // axis has power and is actively controlled HasError : BOOL; // error pending at the axis HasWarning : BOOL; // warning pending at the axis AxisFollowCommand : BOOL; // axis follows the control's command values InPosition : BOOL; // at target position InVelocity : BOOL; // at target velocity InTorque : BOOL; // at target torque InSyncWindow : BOOL; // slave/master command difference within the InSync window InSynchronization : BOOL; // slave follows its master and has reached the master command value OverrideIsZero : BOOL; // velocity override is zero TorqueCtrlPosVelLim : BOOL; // torque control, positive velocity limit reached TorqueCtrlNegVelLim : BOOL; // torque control, negative velocity limit reached // Actual values ActualPos : LREAL; // actual position ActualVel : LREAL; // actual velocity ActualTRQ : LREAL; // actual torque ActualTRQPercent : LREAL; // actual torque in % of rated torque (S-0-0533) DriveStatusWord : WORD; // drive status word (bit 15 power section ready, bit 13 fault) DeviceErrorCode : UDINT; // drive diagnostic number (16#FFFFFFFF with no drive connected) // State machine PlcOpenState : UDINT; // PLCopen state (values not documented; not used) END_STRUCT END_TYPE

TYPE ST_AxisRtConfig : STRUCT bValid : BOOL; // node open and map read: readers may read udiRevision : UDINT; // map revision, passed to BeginAccess astAxis : ARRAY[0..GVL_Axes.LAST_AXIS] OF ST_AxisRtOffsets; // offsets per axis END_STRUCT END_TYPE

TYPE ST_AxisRtOffsets : STRUCT bComplete : BOOL; // every field was found in the map: the axis can be read audiOffset : ARRAY[0..GVL_AxisRtMap.LAST_FIELD] OF UDINT; // byte offset of each field in the buffer abFound : ARRAY[0..GVL_AxisRtMap.LAST_FIELD] OF BOOL; // diag: field found on a byte boundary END_STRUCT END_TYPE
{attribute 'qualified_only'} {attribute 'strict'} TYPE E_MachineState : ( Off := 0, TurningOn, Idle, Starting, Running, Stopping, Holding, Hold, UnHolding, Aborting, Aborted, Resetting ); END_TYPE

TYPE ST_StateClientData : STRUCT bEnabled : BOOL; // client takes part in AllDone and the request ORs (FALSE until a unit drives it) bOn : BOOL; // request: turn machine on bOff : BOOL; // request: turn machine off (acts in Idle) bStart : BOOL; // request: start production bStop : BOOL; // request: controlled stop bHold : BOOL; // request: hold while TRUE bAbort : BOOL; // request: abort uiAbortCode : UINT; // reason for bAbort, unit specific bReset : BOOL; // request: reset after abort eStateEcho : E_MachineState; // machine state the unit is acting on bDone : BOOL; // unit has finished eStateEcho END_STRUCT END_TYPE
